Here’s a concise summary of the iOS app in `ios-app-for-reference-during-porting/miataru`:

---

## 1. Project structure (folders, modules, targets)

**Root:** `ios-app-for-reference-during-porting/miataru/`

| Item | Path / description |
|------|---------------------|
| **Main app source** | `miataru/` (SwiftUI app, file-system–synced in Xcode) |
| **Widget extension** | `miataruWidgets/` |
| **Unit tests** | `miataruTests/` |
| **UI tests** | `miataruUITests/` |
| **Libraries (local SPM)** | `Libraries/` (CodeScanner-main, QRCode-main, MiataruClientSwift) |

**Targets (from `project.pbxproj`):**

- **miataru** – main iOS app (iPhone/iPad), bundle ID `com.miataru.ios`
- **miataruWidgets** – WidgetKit extension, bundle ID `com.miataru.ios.miataruWidgetsExtension`
- **miataruTests** – unit tests
- **miataruUITests** – UI tests

**Main app source layout under `miataru/`:**

- **Entry / app:** `miataruApp.swift` (@main, `miataruApp` struct)
- **Views:** `views/` – `OnboardingContainerView`, `MiataruRootView`; platform subfolders: `iPhone/`, `iPad/`, `Mac/`; `Common/` for shared UI
- **Location:** `LocationManagers/` – `LocationManager.swift`, `DeviceLocationRefresher.swift`
- **Settings / data:** `SettingsManagers/` – `SettingsManager`, `App Settings/` (Devices, Groups), `SharedWidgetData.swift`, `WidgetDataSyncCoordinator.swift`, `RouteRequestCounter.swift`, `WidgetRequestCounter.swift`, `AppDirectories.swift`
- **Device key / auth:** `DeviceKeyAuthHandler.swift`
- **Helpers:** `SoundEffectPlayer.swift`, etc.

---

## 2. Screens / views and purpose

| Screen / view | File(s) | Purpose |
|---------------|---------|--------|
| **Root (device-specific)** | `views/MiataruRootView.swift` | Dispatches to iPhone/iPad/Mac root |
| **iPhone root (tabs)** | `views/iPhone/iPhone_RootView.swift` | TabView: Devices, My QR, Settings; device-key banner/sheet |
| **Devices list** | `views/iPhone/iPhone_DevicesView.swift` | List of known devices + visitor history; add device, add group, map, navigation |
| **Device map** | `views/iPhone/Devices Views/iPhone_DeviceMapView.swift` | Map for one device; location + history; preload history |
| **Device navigation** | `views/iPhone/Devices Views/iPhone_DeviceNavigationView.swift` | Turn-by-turn style; uses NavigationOverlayKit; route reload |
| **Add device** | `views/iPhone/Devices Views/iPhone_AddDeviceView.swift` | Add by ID or QR (CodeScanner) |
| **Edit device** | `views/iPhone/Devices Views/iPhone_EditDeviceView.swift` | Edit name, slogan, access; optional QR (QRCode) |
| **Device history map** | `views/iPhone/Devices Views/DeviceHistoryMap/iPhone_DeviceHistoryMapView.swift` | Timeline/history map for a device |
| **My device QR** | `views/iPhone/iPhone_MyDeviceQRCodeView.swift` | Own device QR (QRCode), share, visitor list |
| **Visitor history** | `views/iPhone/iPhone_VisitorHistoryView.swift` | Who visited this device (visitor history API) |
| **Device key sheet** | `views/iPhone/iPhone_DeviceKeySheetView.swift` | Enter/confirm device key (MiataruAPIClient `setDeviceKey`) |
| **Groups list** | `views/iPhone/iPhone_GroupsView.swift` | List of groups; add/edit; group map |
| **Group map** | `views/iPhone/Groups Views/iPhone_GroupMapView.swift` | Map for a group’s devices |
| **Group detail / add** | `views/iPhone/Groups Views/iPhone_GroupDetailView.swift`, `iPhone_AddGroupView.swift` | Edit group, add group |
| **Settings** | `views/iPhone/Settings Views/iPhone_SettingsView.swift` | Server URL, tracking, history, map, etc.; link to location status |
| **Location status** | `views/iPhone/Settings Views/iPhone_LocationStatusView.swift` | Location permission, server status, background updates |
| **Onboarding (container)** | `views/OnboardingContainerView.swift`, `views/iPhone/iPhone_OnboardingContainerView.swift` | Full vs post-update onboarding; page flow |
| **Onboarding steps** | `views/iPhone/Onboarding/iPhone_1_OnboardingWelcomeView.swift` … `iPhone_8_OnboardingAllowedDeviceListView.swift` | Welcome, permissions, server, QR, history options, device key, allowed devices, done |
| **iPad** | `views/iPad/` | iPad variants of root, devices, groups, device map, onboarding |
| **Mac** | `views/Mac/` | Mac root and onboarding (optional) |
| **Common** | `views/Common/` | `WidgetMapSnapshotGenerator`, `TimelineRangeSlider`, `PlaybackSpeedOverlay`, `RouteInfoState`, `MutualNavigationDetector`, `ViewModifiers`, `DeviceRowView` |

---

## 3. Features (auth, location, settings, etc.)

- **Auth / device key:** Device key set via `iPhone_DeviceKeySheetView`; `MiataruAPIClient.setDeviceKey`; 401/403 and “device key” errors handled by `DeviceKeyAuthHandler` (notifications `deviceKeyAuthRequired` / `deviceKeyAuthResolved`).
- **Location:** `LocationManager` – foreground + background, permission flow, server uploads (`MiataruAPIClient.updateLocation`), activity type, sensitivity; `DeviceLocationRefresher` for polling device locations.
- **Settings:** `SettingsManager` – server URL, track/report, history on server, retention, map type/interval/zoom, history days, activity type, sensitivity, autolock, device key, allowed list, navigation, etc.; persisted in `UserDefaults`.
- **Devices & groups:** `KnownDeviceStore` (device list), `DeviceGroupStore` (groups); add/edit device, add/edit group, device key and slogan via API.
- **Maps & navigation:** Device map, group map, history map; turn-by-turn with NavigationOverlayKit; route updates and reload.
- **Onboarding:** Full onboarding and post-update; completion stored in `UserDefaults` (`hasCompletedOnboarding`, `hasShownPostUpdateOnboarding`).
- **Deep link:** `miataru://<deviceID>` opens main app and either navigates to device or shows add-device sheet (`miataruApp.swift` `handleIncomingURL`).
- **Widgets:** Home screen widgets (text + map) using shared App Group data; see §5 and §7.

---

## 4. Dependencies (CocoaPods, SPM, frameworks)

- **No CocoaPods** in the main app (only in `Libraries/QRCode-main/Demo/Cocoapods Test/`).
- **Swift Package Manager:**
  - **Local packages:**  
    - `Libraries/CodeScanner-main` → **CodeScanner**  
    - `Libraries/QRCode-main` → **QRCode**  
    - `Libraries/MiataruClientSwift` → **MiataruAPIClient**
  - **Remote:**  
    - **NavigationOverlayKit** – `https://github.com/bietiekay/NavigationOverlayKit` (≥1.0.0)  
  - Resolved: NavigationOverlayKit 1.1.0; QRCode pulls in swift-qrcode-generator, SwiftImageReadWrite (from `Package.resolved`).
- **Frameworks:** SwiftUI, UIKit, Combine, CoreLocation, MapKit, WidgetKit, Network; main app uses CodeScanner, QRCode, MiataruAPIClient, NavigationOverlayKit; widget extension uses only MiataruAPIClient.

---

## 5. Data models and persistence

| Model / store | File | Persistence |
|---------------|------|-------------|
| **KnownDevice** | `SettingsManagers/App Settings/Devices/KnownDevice.swift` | `KnownDeviceStore`: `knownDevices.plist` in Application Support, `NSKeyedArchiver` / `NSSecureCoding`. Properties: DeviceName, DeviceID, DeviceIsInGroup, KnownDevicesTablePosition, DeviceColor, hasCurrentLocationAccess, hasHistoryAccess. |
| **DeviceGroup** | `SettingsManagers/App Settings/Groups/DeviceGroup.swift` | `DeviceGroupStore`: `deviceGroups.plist`, same pattern. groupName, deviceIDs (Set), groupPosition. |
| **CachedDeviceLocation** | `SettingsManagers/App Settings/Devices/DeviceLocationCacheStore.swift` | `DeviceLocationCacheStore`: file in Application Support, NSCoding. deviceID, lat/lon, accuracy, timestamp, battery, altitude, speed, placemark. |
| **Device slogan cache** | `SettingsManagers/App Settings/Devices/DeviceSloganCacheStore.swift` | Fetches/stores device slogan via API. |
| **Device history cache** | `SettingsManagers/App Settings/Devices/DeviceHistoryCacheStore.swift` | Caches location history. |
| **Ignored visitors** | `SettingsManagers/App Settings/Devices/IgnoredVisitorDeviceStore.swift` | UserDefaults. |
| **This device ID** | `SettingsManagers/App Settings/thisDeviceIDManager.swift` | File in Application Support (or legacy); load/save device ID. |
| **Settings** | `SettingsManagers/App Settings/SettingsManager.swift` | UserDefaults (keys in `Keys` enum). |
| **Widget payload** | `SettingsManagers/SharedWidgetData.swift` | App Group `group.com.miataru.ios`: `S

---
